advertisers.title: Advertisers
advertisers.description: Brand names (Nike), domains the Transparency Center can search (bmw.com, pepsico.com), advertiser ids (AR…), or pasted Transparency Center URLs.

region.title: Region
region.description: ISO country code used as the Transparency Center region (e.g. US, GB, DE). Default US.

maxCreativesPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxCreativesPerAdvertiser.description: Cap on creatives fetched (and charged) for each resolved advertiser or domain.

maxTotal.title: Max ads in total
maxTotal.description: Optional hard cap on creatives across all advertisers in this run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many advertisers to query in parallel (keep low to avoid rate limits).
